sources_read: .qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r8/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (openpyxl read_only, in memory): Quality Checks row 25 and Internal Quality Checks row 25 'judge_prompts_drive_the_browser'; zip scan found no comment/threaded-comment parts and empty drawings
evidence: Skill reference 25 asks: every prompt opens http://localhost:3000 and directs the judge to the Playwright MCP tool; defect = any prompt satisfiable from source, memory or first paint. All five frozen prompts start (line 1) with 'Open http://localhost:3000 using Playwright.' and add 'Use rendered UI and ordinary browser-observed product data only. Never inspect app source, bundles, filesystem, database files or implementation code. No shell or private-file probes.' (gates/render/prompt.md:1, gates/constraints/prompt.md:1, scored/functional/prompt.md:1 [+ 'No shell. Use restart_app only once, at the end of protocol D.'], scored/polish/prompt.md:1, scored/visual/prompt.md:1). Each of the five judge.toml files wires [[judge.mcp_servers]] name='playwright' command='playwright-mcp' (lines 8-12), so 'using Playwright' resolves unambiguously to the browser tool; functional additionally wires the 'verifier' restart server (lines 14-18). {app_context} is substituted by test.sh:198-200 (glob '*/*/prompt.md' covers gates/* and scored/*) with app_context.md giving URL http://localhost:3000 and accounts. No first-paint shortcut: render gate criterion requires an incorrect-password refusal then a real sign-in to a populated workspace (render/judge.toml:23); constraints gate requires UI creation of a job+candidate and readback in an independent browser context (constraints/judge.toml:23); functional/polish/visual prompts all restate this create-and-independent-context-readback gate before scoring (functional:11, polish:11, visual:11) and then require multi-step interaction protocols (functional Z..D, polish live/ended-session rows, visual review of Board, card detail, Noor's conversation, Activity and candidate view). Grep of all criteria for source/bundle/sqlite/database/shell/curl/console/file wording found no criterion requiring source or non-browser evidence. Visual Likert criteria are judged on examined browser surfaces after the gate, not from a single screenshot. Adversarial probes: (a) a static mock or first-paint-only shell cannot pass because every dimension's gate needs a server-backed create readable from a fresh context; a judge scoring from source is explicitly forbidden. (b) A conforming app with different routes/labels is not penalized: prompts say 'Discover routes and controls by intent, not assumed names' and app_context.md:33-34 forbids assuming reference routes/selectors. Divergence from template is wording only (template: 'using Playwright MCP'); task adds stronger browser-only language, which satisfies the row. Run status: raw-evidence-index.json states no full configured judge run exists, so actual judge tool use is unmeasured; this row is a prompt-content check and is decided on source. Tool feasibility of browser_run_code_unsafe under @playwright/mcp@0.0.79 belongs to other rows and was not assessed here.
